name: Violet City Gym & Leader Falkner
summary: Step into the open-air rafters of Violet City Gym, where suspended wooden walkways and pulley platforms sway high above the arena. Defeat Falkner's devoted Bird Keepers before challenging the aerial master in a 5 vs 5 duel. Counter his Lightning Rod traps and Air Balloon pivots to secure the Zephyr Badge and claim TM40 Aerial Ace.

items.name: TM40 Aerial Ace
items.method: Rewarded by Gym Leader Falkner upon winning the Zephyr Badge

items.name: Falkner's Cage
items.method: Exclusive vanity outfit hat awarded for conquering Violet Gym
